final:
def fact(n: int) -> bigint:
    """Factorial of n as an arbitrary-precision integer."""
    pre n >= 0
    post out >= 1
    ex fact(0) == 1
    ex fact(5) == 120
    ex fact(20) == 2432902008176640000
    result: bigint = bigint(1)
    for i in range(2, n + 1):
        result = result * bigint(i)
    return result
